title: Does the Prefill Vulnerability Shrink with Reasoning Effort?

original_idea.body: Mapping goal-misgeneralization triggers as a minimal model organism (extends arXiv:2210.01790, motivated by arXiv:2511.22619): tiny text env with a spurious correlate, prompt an open instruct model, rank which correlate types induce misgeneralization OOD. No training.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Goal misgeneralization is a core inner-alignment failure; a shareable model organism is a strong, defensible chain.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Tiny text environment + prompting an open instruct model, no training; beginner-feasible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Focused ranked-trigger-list deliverable; cataloguing several correlate types adds breadth.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Model organisms are explicitly neglected long-horizon gold; open models, no training.

novelty.reasoning: In-context goal-misgeneralization organism is scarce; likely mostly novel.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Minimal LLM-agent goal-misgen organism is scarce.
